verdict.rationale: Check documents an MCP server that lets external AI clients such as Claude or ChatGPT query payroll data and generate reports in natural language. The AI and its insights live in the third-party client, so this is an adjacent building block, not AI-generated insights delivered inside Check itself. No evidence shows Check producing its own AI insights or suggestions in its Console or Components.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
